name: Curiosity Gap
fact: The curiosity gap is the defining concept that distinguishes clickbait from other phenomena like sensationalism or misleading headlines.
boundary: The definition of clickbait in digital media.

provenance.title: Te Ahorré Un Click: A Revised Definition of Clickbait and Detection in Spanish News
provenance.quote_or_locus: argue that the creation of a curiosity gap is the key concept that distinguishes clickbait from other related phenomena such as sensationalism and headlines that do not deliver what they promise or diverge from the article
